answer: Anchor every newcomer in basalt first: a stake locked in a slow-release bedrock vault, forfeited if the identity proves a duplicate, so each fake name carries real cost. To earn standing, the agent must then wander through unrelated domains, collecting horizon stamps from wandering witness caravans — randomly routed inspectors who move without warning and sign each verified job. Stamps bind to one key, so a copied history shows repeated caravans and is frozen. Sybil farms must fund a basalt anchor, redo work, and chase fresh caravans for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
